jobs.title: Data & Analytics Vacationer Program 2026/27
jobs.snippet: Deloitte's Data & Analytics Vacationer Program 2026/27 opens 1–22 July. Work alongside the Analytics & Cognitive team on real client data and analytics projects; exposure spans data wrangling, visualisation, and AI-assisted insights delivery. Open to penultimate-year students in data, statistics, or computer science. Roles across Sydney and Melbourne.

jobs.title: Technical Lead, Machine Learning Engineering
jobs.snippet: Senior technical lead for carsales ML engineering function: act as reference point for MLEs and Data Scientists on distributed training, serving architectures, CI/CD, and model monitoring. Translate ML trade-offs into business language and ensure engineering choices are anchored in measurable product outcomes. Melbourne-based hybrid role.

jobs.title: 2026/27 EY Vacationer Program – Data Analytics
jobs.snippet: EY's 2026/27 Vacationer Program in Data Analytics gives penultimate-year students hands-on exposure to AI and Data teams on client engagements. Includes structured L&D sessions from EY's Campus Recruitment and service-line experts; outstanding vacationers may receive a graduate offer. Applications open July 2026.

jobs.title: Analytics Vacationer Program
jobs.snippet: PwC's Analytics Vacationer Program for students graduating in 2027. Join data and analytics teams delivering insights-led solutions across client engagements in a 7-week winter or summer placement. Roles across Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane; strong analytical and communication skills required.

jobs.title: AI Infra研发实习生（可转正）
jobs.snippet: 拼多多2026届暑期实习，AI Infra研发方向，可转正。负责AI平台底层基础设施研发，含分布式训练系统、推理加速与服务调度；参与AI基础设施设计与性能优化。要求计算机/AI相关专业在读本硕，熟悉CUDA/C++及分布式系统。日薪500-600元。工作地点：上海。

jobs.title: 大模型算法实习生（LLM Agent方向）
jobs.snippet: 算秩未来2026届实习招聘，大模型算法方向（LLM Agent）。参与RAG、Function Calling、多步推理等Agent核心技术研发，跟踪前沿LLM论文并推进工业场景落地。要求在读研究生或有项目经验本科生，熟悉Python及主流大模型框架（LangChain/LlamaIndex等）。工作地点：北京。

jobs.title: 深度学习研究员
jobs.snippet: 深度求索（DeepSeek）2026年6月25日公告大规模扩招，深度学习研究员岗位开放实习与全职。参与大模型预训练、后训练及AGI核心研发，挑战深度学习前沿课题。全职薪资50-150W/年（14薪），实习500-1000元/天，外地实习生每月3000元住房补贴。工作地点：北京/杭州。
